name: pr-flow
summary: Use when checking, watching or merging a GitHub PR, or reading its CI run logs
intents: ci runs for a branch or sha
gh token or keyring auth fallback

exit_codes.0: success: checks passed, status, runs or log printed, merged, or dry-run plan printed
exit_codes.1: negative result: a check failed or none reported, nothing found, merge refused or rejected
exit_codes.2: usage error, including merge without --match-head or --method
exit_codes.3: environment failure: missing gh or jq, auth failed in every mode, repo unresolved, gh error
exit_codes.4: checks still pending: --timeout expired while watching, or pending without --watch

distinct_from.reason: job-watch watches local background processes; pr-flow polls GitHub pull request checks and workflow runs
